newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon economic activity up in May - C. Bank.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon economic activity up in May - C. Bank.

text.p: Lebanon's economic activity picked up in May to its highest level in seven months, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Friday.
The central bank said its coincident indicator of economic activity rose to 173.7 from 170.3 a month earlier, remaining well above last May's 164.8.

"Economic activity remained on a positive course since March as suggested by the Banque Du Liban coincident indicator which rose to 173.7 in May against 170.3 in April and 166.0 in March," the Bank said.

The indicator, which takes January 1993 as 100, combines 12 economic series including imports, exports, electricity output and airport and port activity. The bank has not revealed the weighting of the different series and some economists question its value.
The Bank created the indicator because of a lack of reliable data in Lebanon since the 1975-90 war, which prevents precise calculation of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and economic growth.
